_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in what you need. Every section is optional - the server merges whatever it finds over its built-in defaults. Nothing here is required to start AirChat and talk to a friend over AirChat itself.
_publicUrl_comment: Normally left alone: 'Start AirChat + Public Link.bat' fills this in with the tunnel's address and clears it again when the tunnel stops. Set it by hand only for a permanent address (see README) - AirChat then tests it once at startup, because a link that outlived its tunnel only looks real.
_token_comment: Leave empty to let AirChat generate one on first run. Local requests never need it; anyone connecting from outside your PC does.
_channels_comment: What each channel actually sends through. 'mock' pretends to deliver so you can try the flow with zero accounts. 'off' disables the channel.
_bluebubbles_comment: Real blue-bubble iMessage. Requires BlueBubbles running on a Mac signed into your Apple ID.
_twilio_comment: Real SMS to any phone number. Needs a Twilio account with a sending number.
_telegram_comment: Free and unlimited. Talk to @BotFather on Telegram to get a bot token.
